name: oni-curses-and-breath
reviewNotes: All 30 original records reviewed. Retain the raw battle terminator 0f, paired dynamic fields, numeric controls and the fixed 128-step curse warning.

Width samples use an eight-cell name plus two-cell suffix for adjacent 09 fields, following the neighboring battle-status draft. Record 13 instead has parenthesized name/reading fields, sampled at six cells each from the published enemy-name maximum. These are static samples, not verified bounds for every runtime producer.
Source もっけの毒 is provisionally 莫克之毒; cross-check the named poison before release. Keep ordinary poison breath, deadly poison breath and this named poison distinct.
